title: Ternary Dot-Product Hardware Feasibility and Matched Binary Baselines
summary: Design C (H-T1 sign-and-mask ternary overlay) yields a minor gate area reduction (~1.09x - 1.10x) over Design B (optimized binary ternary-weight MAC) due to logic representation, but falls far short of the mandatory stopping criteria threshold (1.25x area or energy efficiency advantage). Furthermore, the structural difference between Design B and Design C is an artifact of sign-and-mask vs two's complement decoding input format rather than a true ternary arithmetic advantage. When evaluated against the critical scientific control (Design B), Design C fails to demonstrate a defensible ternary hardware advantage.
unmeasured_or_unsupported_metrics: Silicon physical power (TOPS/W) — UNMEASURED (requires calibrated layout parasitic extraction and dynamic activity waveforms)
Critical path frequency (GHz) — UNMEASURED (unconstrained combinational synthesis without cell library delay timing arcs)
recommendation: STOP all custom ternary hardware research in T81 Foundation per Stopping Criterion 2 of PR #594 / Audit 06.
